components_strategy.forms: Shadcn UI Form/Input components, customized with focus:ring-[#1EC2D7]

animation_guidelines.hover_states: All buttons need hover:scale-[1.02] active:scale-95. Cards need hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-xl.
animation_guidelines.entrance: Use framer-motion for staggered entrance animations on the bento grids (y: 20, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #1EC2D7 text is only used on #04608E or #1A4277 backgrounds. If used on white, use it for large icons or borders, not small text.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use placeholder text or dummy image URLs. For logos, use a combination of Lucide icons and text (e.g. <CircleIcon /> Acme Corp).
Strictly adhere to the selected fonts: Outfit for headings, Manrope for body text.
Build a custom pure HTML/Tailwind Marketing Hero with an abstract CSS-based dot/grid background. DO NOT use Shadcn section components for the hero.
Implement a Bento Grid for the 'Servicios' section. Make the cards asymmetric (e.g., col-span-4 vs col-span-8).
Use Shadcn UI for Tabs (to toggle agent/no-agent services) and Forms (for the contact CTA).
Add 'data-testid' to every link, button, input, and tab.
Install and setup Lenis for smooth scrolling.
Ensure the hero headline does not exceed text-6xl. Do not center everything; use left-alignment to create a sophisticated SaaS aesthetic.
